{"rule": "Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and a new passage of about 250 words in the text field.", "text": "The date was a Thursday in March. He wrote it on nothing, and then found he had it anyway, the way one has a splinter.

February was the shop's worst month and always had been. He sold a road atlas of Wales to a woman who did not want to talk about where she was going, and a boxed set of something to a man who paid in coins counted twice. Between them he reorganised the travel section by country and then by author and then back, and each time the Portuguese verse ended up somewhere it did not belong, because it was not travel and he had never decided what it was.

Ines came alone once, without the scarf man, and did not mention him. She bought nothing and stood at the window a long time with her coat on. He asked if she wanted tea and she said no, and then said yes, and drank it standing. When she left she touched the paperweight, turned it so the bubble faced him, and said nothing about the envelopes under it. He understood that she knew, and that she was letting him have the pretence, and he was more grateful for the second thing than the first.

The repaired strip of road began to lift at one edge where the buses turned. A small thing, a lip of tar. He noticed it every morning and every evening and did not report it, because it was not his, and because he had come to feel that things which were mended badly were at least mended, and he was not sure the men in orange would agree.

The Thursday came nearer in the way Thursdays do."}
